summary: Lukula territory (Kongo-Central, Mayombe region) comprises Lukula town on the Boma-Tshela road, the Kangu mission town and rural villages of the Lukula and Kangu secteurs. No armed group holds territory here; the area is far from the eastern conflict zones. Lukula and Kangu towns are policed by the PNC, which, with territorial administration and customary chiefs, handles order and arrests; FARDC elements are present along the Boma-Tshela axis. Security issues are crime, land disputes and sporadic Bundu dia Kongo-related political unrest in earlier years, none of which displaced state control. Web research was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted), so the assessment rests on default state presence.

zones.description: Lukula town (Khuni/Etat/Yuma Dongo areas) and Kangu town (Mbutu Kangu)
